chunks: Said: "Here are my daughters, if you are so active."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Lot offer his people to satisfy their desire?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights Prophet Lot's (peace be upon him) strategic use of hospitality customs to deter his people, offering his daughters not merely as a sacrifice but as a temporary measure to preserve the honor of his guests. Scholars note that this occurred in a context where marriage laws were more flexible, making the offer a credible diplomatic tool to avert the greater sin of violating the angels. The phrase 'if you are so active' underscores the urgency of their desire, contrasting their physical lust with their spiritual blindness.
